item.text:
Reconstructed all 14 verses in Urdu script and verified that they align line by line with the transcription in `romanLyrics`. Updated the titles and right-to-left direction and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read the ambiguous Roman “Durah” as **دُرّہ** (whip) and retained the original Roman spelling.
